purpose: Phase 1.5 IPPO baseline — per-agent critic (no CTDE) + uniform opponent sampling (no PFSP). Isolates the joint contribution of AlphaStar PFSP league + per-agent critic; compared vs PfspFix (PFSP on) and MAPPO (CTDE on) to decompose the two effects.

host.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, 97887 MiB

notes: Phase 1.5 IPPO baseline (third arm of three-way comparison). Per-agent critic + PFSP off (pfsp_p=0). Decomposes PfspFix-vs-MAPPO into CTDE effect (MAPPO vs IPPO) and PFSP effect (PfspFix vs IPPO). Refactor-era run on phase1.5/three-way-baselines branch.
